description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts consistently across a web application. It includes functions for formatting numeric values as currency strings with dynamic precision, appending credit information for USD, and handling various numeric formats. The primary focus is on displaying monetary values in a user-friendly and uniform manner.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount(value, options = {})
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with options for currency code, precision, and optional appending of credits based on a fixed conversion rate.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText(usd, options = {})
methods.description: Convenience helper that formats a USD amount with credits appended, using the main formatting function.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals(amount)
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with thousands separators and up to six decimal places.
